hero.title: Built by a creator who got tired of editing the hard way. Not another timeline tool. An AI collaborator that understands what you're trying to make.
hero.p1: VIBED is the AI that edits your videos so you don't have to.
hero.p2: The idea was simple: what if you could just describe the edit? Not click through menus. Not drag handles on a timeline. Just say what you want — and have it done.

items.title: The origin
items.body: The principles it's built on: — AI-first: every edit starts with a conversation - Fast: from raw footage to exported video in minutes - Platform-aware: knows what works on YouTube vs TikTok - Non-destructive: nothing is permanent, everything undoable

items.title: The build
items.body: Arriving in France with one goal: learn to build what was imagined in Turkey. The technical skills come together at Epitech — one of France's leading engineering schools — where the first real versions of the product are built, broken, and rebuilt.

items.title: From analysis tool to editing IDE
items.body: The project pivots. What started as a video analysis tool — something that scored footage for virality — becomes something more interesting: a conversational editing environment. An IDE for video, validated by a mentor and teacher who saw the gap in the market clearly.

items.title: VIBED launches
items.body: The first version is live. Podcasters, YouTubers, and documentary makers can now edit by describing what they want — and export to the tools they already use.

items.title: You stay in control
items.body: The AI suggests and executes. You decide. Every action is visible, named, and reversible. Nothing happens inside a black box.

items.title: Work in your tools
items.body: You don't have to abandon Premiere, Final Cut, or DaVinci. VIBED works with the suite you already finish in — not instead of it.

items.title: Editing is creative work
items.body: The mechanical parts — silence removal, cleanup, formatting — shouldn't take your attention. The story should.

items.title: Your footage is yours
items.body: We store it, we process it, we delete it on your schedule. We never train on it, we never share it, we never monetise it.

audience.p1: VIBED is built for long-form creators who edit their own content — podcasters, YouTubers, interviewers, documentary makers. People who have a story to tell and a timeline full of raw footage standing between them and telling it.
audience.p2: Not for teams with dedicated editors. Not for short-form content factories. For the solo creator who films something real, sits down to edit it themselves, and wants the process to get out of the way of the work.

founder.name: Marc NGUIDJOL
founder.bio: From Istanbul to Paris. Master's student in AI at Epitech. Solo founder building VIBED — a conversational video editing IDE for long-form creators. Previously: video analysis tools, hackathons, and a lot of time spent learning what not to build.
